title: Storage
description: Where {product} keeps its files. It's set in the server's configuration, not here.
whereHint: The file system, an S3 bucket (AWS or a server that speaks S3, such as MinIO), or Azure Blob. Files are only ever reached through {product}, which checks who may read them.
previousBody: A file not moved yet is read from where they were before: {provider}, {location}.
copyHint: Copies every file still in the previous storage to the one in use, each checked against the hash kept for it. Files already there are left as they are, so it can be run again. When nothing's left, remove Storage:Previous from the configuration.
copyCounts: {total, plural, one {# file} other {# files}}: {copied} copied, {skipped} already there, {missing} in neither, {failed} couldn't be copied
